In detail

Named for the historic abbeys within it, most notably the Abbazia di Chiaravalle, which draws regular visitors for guided tours, along with the surrounding park used for walking and cycling. No specific crime or safety incidents found — a quiet, semi-rural fringe area. Fine to explore by day, best avoided alone in the more isolated rural stretches after dark.
